costs.intro: A BMW X6 xDrive30d engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X6 xDrive30d engine rebuild starts from £2,800, whether your car has the N57/B57 or the B57. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
